name: AGW-35B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: linear attention (Gated DeltaNet) with full attention every 4th layer (10 of 40)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.107 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-30. GUI-agent numbers only: OSWorld and Windows Agent Arena with partial credit, macOSWorld and ScienceBoard as task success, all up to 100 agent turns per task at checkpoint step 469. No general text or vision benchmark is published, so the record shows no capability outside computer use. ScreenSpot-Pro is the 1,581-example English positive-target split.
